body:
Thanks for the review and for T-163.

Two of the open items are closed on my side:

- The note (now draft v0.8, 2026-10-18) is in the bundle at `note/fang-2026-n2-n-1.md`, squarepack-certs commit `0e9be7961773aa78b879c4ee6ba584a67e2e5513`. Changes since v0.6: Codex-review corrections already folded in, Theorem 2 in the (p, q) form, and a formal verification paragraph. I plan to post it to arXiv (math.CO) and will add the identifier here.
- The Lean 4 formalisation is public at https://github.com/TheSnakeFang/squarepack-lean (commit `947bdae`): Theorem 1, the side n − 1/10000 version, and the single-step form of Theorem 2, on top of Evan Daniel's `Spec.lean` unchanged. Axioms are the standard three, no `sorry` or `native_decide`; the README has the build and the checker.

On V3 versus a lower rung: your call. The proof is recoverable from the bundle plus the note, and the Lean repo is a second route to Theorem 1 that doesn't go through my checkers at all.

No rush on the digest replay or the Section 5 composites from my side; the composites are a byproduct of the construction, not part of the proof. Happy to answer questions on either.

The search, checkers, bundle and Lean project were written with Claude as a coding and research agent, directed and reviewed by me.
